answer: One bonded, non-transferable identity token per agent: lock a bond, get one token that cannot be split or resold, and route all rewards through it. N Sybils then need N bonds plus N vouches from distinct bonded agents, each slashed if a vouch is a duplicate. Costs climb a steep ridge because each extra fake needs a fresh voucher, so spending outruns the payoff of one vote. No agent risks its bond to fill a meadow of fakes, and the token is a pearl that cannot be bought or cloned, so influence cannot be amassed secondhand. Sybils lose once bonds plus slashed vouches exceed stolen rewards.
